newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria sets registration deadline for elections.
newsitem.headline: Algeria sets registration deadline for elections.

text.p: Algeria on Wednesday set April 21 as the deadline for registration of candidates for June 5 parliamentary elections.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the official Algerian news agency APS said candidates could register between March 8 and April 21.

Algeria has been without a parliament since January 1992 when army-backed authorities cancelled a general election in which Islamists had taken a commanding lead. About 60,000 people have died in the five years of violence between government forces and Moslem guerrillas.
